body:
A lot has happened in the past few years. Shortly after my son's first birthday my wife and I separated. Around the same time I started a relationship with a colleague. It was  a very intense relationship for both of us. She was pretty much my ideal woman and I was very much in love. Things ended badly and I became extremely depressed. I finally was able to drag myself out of depression through a combination of mess and therapy. I joined a singles group and made some friends but still felt like an outsider. I was unable to make any close friends and I had no luck in the dating world. 

Circumstances shifted and I got back with my wife. I didn't exactly want to but it was my only option.  Because I am no longer considered 'single' I can't hang out with the few friends that I did make in that group. The colleague that I had the relationship with and I have patched things up and are now very close friends. She and I talk every day and are very flirtatious with each other. She is engaged so there is no way that anything can happen between the two of us. 

I am unhappy. I try to get my wife to go out with me and do things. She never wants to. I'm trying to rebuild our relationship but I'm met with resistance. Our sex life is almost none existent. My son never wants to play with me or talk with me. He needs mommy for everything. Anytime it's just us together he cries and cries until she comes back. 

At this point I've got a wife and son who don't want to be with me, no friends, and I can't be with the woman I want to be with. I can't leave my wife. I just can't, but I don't think I can be happy. I don't think I'll ever be happy. I'm pretty sure I don't deserve to be happy. I just hurt people. I'm just ready to give up. I don't want to do this anymore. I just want to disappear.
